title: Rethinking Generalization in Reasoning SFT: A Conditional Analysis on Optimization, Data, and Model Capability
abstract: arXiv:2604.06628v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: A prevailing narrative in LLM post-training holds that supervised finetuning (SFT) memorizes while reinforcement learning (RL) generalizes. We revisit this claim for reasoning SFT with long chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision and find that cross-domain generalization is not absent but conditional, jointly shaped by optimization dynamics, training data, and base-model capability. Some reported failures are under-optimization artifacts: cross-domain performance first degrades before recovering and improving with extended training (a dip-and-recovery pattern), so shorttraining checkpoints can underestimate generalization. Data quality and structure both matter: low-quality solutions broadly hurt generalization,while verified long-CoT traces yield consistent cross-domain gains. Model capability is essential: stronger models internalize transferable procedural patterns (e.g., backtracking) even from a toy arithmetic game, while weaker ones

translated_title: 重新思考推理SFT中的泛化：关于优化、数据与模型能力的条件分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.06628v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：在LLM后训练中，一种普遍的说法是监督微调（SFT）倾向于记忆，而强化学习（RL）则能泛化。我们针对带有长思维链（CoT）监督的推理SFT重新审视了这一观点，并发现跨领域泛化并非不存在，而是有条件的，它由优化动态、训练数据和基础模型能力共同塑造。一些报道中的失败是欠优化的产物：跨领域性能在训练初期先下降，随后随着训练延长而恢复并提升（即“先降后升”模式），因此短训练检查点可能会低估泛化能力。数据的质量和结构都至关重要：低质量的解决方案普遍损害泛化能力，而经过验证的长CoT轨迹则能带来一致的跨领域收益。模型能力是关键：更强的模型即使从玩具算术游戏中也能内化可迁移的程序性模式（例如回溯），而较弱的模型则无法做到。
tldr: 推理SFT的跨领域泛化并非缺失，而是由优化动态、数据质量和模型能力共同决定的条件性现象，表现为“先降后升”模式，且强模型能内化可迁移的程序性模式。
en_tdlr: Cross-domain generalization in reasoning SFT is not absent but conditional, shaped by optimization dynamics, data quality, and model capability, exhibiting a dip-and-recovery pattern where stronger models internalize transferable procedural patterns.
